# Introduction {.unnumbered}

**Unit 3: Brains and Neural Networks** (Weeks 4-6)

A real look at how brain cells work, and how computer scientists copied the idea to build AI. We will act out a neural network as a class, watch one learn in real time on screen, and see how the same basic idea powers everything from chatbots to image generators and self-driving cars.

***

## What You'll Learn

By the end of this unit, you will be able to:

* Explain how a brain cell (neuron) sends a signal
* Explain how an artificial neural network copies that idea
* Act out a neural network as a class
* Watch a neural network learn, and train one yourself
